title: Download piped to shell (shell) — review required
description: A download is piped straight into a shell: curls+[^|]*|s*(?:ba)?shb. The executed bytes are whatever the network returned — tampering, truncation, or a compromised server runs attacker code. This lexical rule flags the pipe; the reviewer confirms verification or removes it.
remediation: Download, verify (checksum/signature verification), then execute as separate steps; never pipe network bytes to a shell.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the pipe regardless of transport or verification.
